rationale: The persona prizes precise, principled distinctions over broad category exclusions. Option 1 offers a sharper, criterion-based test (a concrete buyer whose purchase itself raises safety) rather than sweeping governance into a blanket 'unsuitable' bucket, and defaults conservatively to non-profit funding—matching the researcher's preference for well-founded, mechanism-aware analysis and skepticism of commercial incentive distortions. Option 2 is plausible but uses a coarser category-level carve-out.
